regressions_audited.description: No fake 30-district MultiPolygons drawn on canvas
regressions_audited.truth_basis: Zero district polygon datasets in repository; district browsing strictly metadata/centroid

regressions_audited.description: No fake live vehicle location or animated bus pins
regressions_audited.truth_basis: Transit data is scheduled only; no vehicle hardware telemetry

regressions_audited.description: No straight-line transit chords between unresolved stops
regressions_audited.truth_basis: Missing route geometry suppresses polyline completely

regressions_audited.description: No candidate-stop first-mile walking or navigation claims
regressions_audited.truth_basis: First-mile calculation strictly restricted to VERIFIED_OFFICIAL and VERIFIED_GEOSPATIAL stops

regressions_audited.description: No locality-only stops placed at fake pin coordinates

regressions_audited.description: No silent fallback to Bhubaneswar as fake GPS location on permission denial

regressions_audited.description: No route geometry fabricated from stop-to-stop straight lines
regressions_audited.truth_basis: Only surveyed road geometry renders as polylines

regressions_audited.description: No civic essentials leaking into cultural leisure destinations
regressions_audited.truth_basis: 211 civic essentials strictly segregated into dedicated, mutually exclusive Essentials layer
